decisions.reason: Although conferencing is adjacent to the firm's communications capabilities, two years without website visibility and the firm's shift toward differentiated software-defined infrastructure make a standalone conferencing offer a weak use of absorptive and commercial resources.

Metro data-centre connectivity directly exploits the firm's fibre, metro footprint and enterprise network knowledge, and its earlier adoption signal fits the strategic move toward cloud and high-bandwidth infrastructure services.

Optical spectrum connectivity builds very strongly on existing network assets and specialist engineering know-how, so the firm has high absorptive capacity to refine and commercialise it even if marketing visibility has changed.

The portal uses existing voice and provisioning knowledge, but as voice becomes less central and digital ordering can be folded into broader customer platforms, management would likely redeploy resources away from this standalone offer.

Direct voice network connection remains close to current capabilities, but weak recent visibility and the firm's stronger strategic pull toward cloud, data-centre and software-defined services make withdrawal more likely than continued dedicated development.
